name: Danielle
source:
Dawn's best friend since childhood, she's always pushing her BFF to try new things.

Dani is a girl who knows what she wants at all times, and has no problem taking it. She is blunt, candid, and speaks her mind constantly, but is not above manipulation and white lies to turn a situation in her favour. She and her brother are trust fund babies, but she is generous to her friends, crafty and practical, just wanting the best for everyone in all situations. Her demanding personality can make her taxing in tough times, however. Despite her go-getter 'tude, she hasn't been challenged much in life, so she may respond to hardship with petulance, denial, and a retreat into her own head.
